display_long_description:
Swing. Fight. Flip. Repeat.

Swing, flip, fight, and pray your way through an incredible open world and more than 7 campaign levels. Web Weaver is a physics-based web-swinging superhero game where every jump is one bad grip away from glorious disaster. Even better, you can play with your friends.

[media]

**SWING THROUGH THE CITY**

 Fully physics-driven web-swinging. No rails, no autopilot. Nail a perfect arc between rooftops and feel like a god. Miss and eat pavement.

[media]

**BECOME HERO'S WITH YOUR FRIENDS**

 Multiplayer mayhem. Swing together, fight eachother, race through the city, or become city-wide menaces. Everything is better with a squad of web-weavers.

[media]

**INSANE COMBAT**

Crazy enemies.  Tenticles.  Grappling.  Experience the most insane VR superhero combat on the market.  Fast gameplay, multiple enemies, and unique Web mechanics make Web-Weaver combat a must play.

**Grab a web. Get moving. Try not to scream.**
